# HEK Design Studio

HEK Design Studio is a boutique web design and development studio. We offer end-to-end design and development for small businesses and nonprofits, with pricing from $500 to $3,000+.

## About

- Homepage: Studio overview, services summary, process, and differentiators
- About: Team bios for Harrison Kipper (Design Lead) and Erik Kleiman (Development Lead)

## Services

- Services: Strategy & UX, Visual Design Systems, Development & Launch, Optimization & Support
- Pricing: Three tiers — Bronze ($500–$1K), Silver ($1.5K–$3K), Gold ($3K+)

## Work

- Portfolio: Featured projects including Jewmanity, Virufy, and Trade Up
